compute_fid: compute the Frechet Inception Distance between real and generated image datasets using Inception v3 features
run_compute_fid: run compute_fid to evaluate GAN image quality by comparing real and generated feature statistics
test_compute_fid: test compute_fid with synthetic mean and covariance matrices to verify FID calculation correctness
review_compute_fid: review compute_fid to understand how it uses scipy.linalg.sqrtm for matrix square root computation
summarize_compute_fid: summarize compute_fid which calculates FID from Inception v3 feature means and covariances of real vs generated images
